(EDGE CASE) A junior engineer proposes: 'Since LPDDR6 adds Memory Region Isolation (MRI), and we already run a type-1 hypervisor with Stage-2 translation via SMMUv3, can we skip the MRI table programming in ATF BL2 and rely on Stage-2 instead?'

Is this safe? What is the architectural layering of DRAM-controller-level MRI vs SMMU Stage-2 vs EL2 Stage-2 page tables? Do they overlap in function, and if one fails (e.g., hypervisor bug), which is the last-line defense for secure memory? Walk through the correct threat model.
